address: 2352 Coles Bay Rd, Coles Bay, Tasmania 7215, Australia
tagline: Twenty suites facing the Hazards, on Great Oyster Bay.
description:
Saffire Freycinet stands at 2352 Coles Bay Road, Coles Bay, on the east coast of Tasmania, looking across Great Oyster Bay to the Hazards. Federal Group opened it in 2010. Circa Morris-Nunn Architects gave the building a long curve compared on the lodge's own story page to a manta ray, with glass toward the pink granite of the mountains. In 2025 the lodge marked 15 years, and it records more than 85,000 room nights. The published coordinates are latitude -42.10963 and longitude 148.26595. The drive is about two and a half hours from Hobart and two hours from Launceston. A helicopter with Freycinet Air can make the hop from Hobart in under 45 minutes. The lodge does not print an airport code.

There are 20 suites. The Saffire Jewel is a three-bedroom residence of 800 square metres indoors and out, with a heated infinity pool and a jacuzzi. Other suites have decks toward the Hazards. The stay includes all meals, Tasmanian wines and a selection of drinks, with evening canapes or afternoon tea in the lounge. A gym is part of the wellness rooms. Some signature experiences are included and others are paid for separately.

Palate Restaurant is for guests of the lodge. After canapes in the lounge, dinner is a daily degustation or an a la carte menu, using produce from local farms and the bay. The lounge serves coffee in the morning and, from 5.30pm, cocktails, small-batch gins, single malt whiskies and wine.

The setting is used for time on the water and on the peninsula: the Freycinet coast, the Hazards, and the oyster farms of Great Oyster Bay are the days the lodge builds around the dining room. National telephone is 1800 723 347, and from abroad +61 3 6256 7888. The desk is stay@saffire-freycinet.com.au.

Saffire Freycinet suits travellers who want a small lodge of 20 suites on the Freycinet coast, with meals and Tasmanian wine included and the Hazards in the glass.
